Top Chennai Police Officer Questioned in POCSO Case

Arun, a former Chennai police chief holding the rank of Additional Director General of Police (ADGP), was questioned by a Special Investigation Team (SIT) in connection with the Veeramani POCSO case. The case involves allegations of child abuse.
